critical.issue: Returns 500 (pydantic ValidationError, not a 4xx) when recurrence is 'annual', 'semiannual' or 'bimonthly', or category is 'logistics', 'tax', 'energy', 'telephony' or 'admin'. Root cause: models_control.FixedCostRecurrence = Literal['monthly','quarterly','yearly','one_off'] and FixedCostCategory has no logistics/tax/energy/telephony/admin, but FixedCostReconciliation.jsx REC=['monthly','bimonthly','quarterly','semiannual','annual'] and CATS include those values. FixedCostCreate accepts any str, so the error only appears at FixedCost(**d) in management_control.create_fixed (line 69) and becomes a 500. _monthly_amount also does not handle annual/semiannual/bimonthly (it falls back to the raw amount).

ui_bugs.issue: Recurrence/category options don't match what the backend accepts (see backend issue). The PO-requested 'annual' recurrence can't be saved. A failed save only shows the generic 'Si è verificato un errore. Riprova.'

When Admin Master saves 31-40% directly, 'Approvato da' shows the raw user UUID instead of the email (approved_by_email is not set on the auto-approve path; the commercial→admin approve path shows the email correctly)

After a >30% discount is saved or approved, reloading the page still shows discount-over-30-box with an empty reason, 'MOTIVAZIONE OBBLIGATORIA', and Applica disabled. discountReason is not loaded from quote.discount_approval.reason. The margin panel also still shows 'Sconto massimo disponibile 30,00 %' and 'SCONTO > 30% — AUTORIZZAZIONE DIREZIONE RICHIESTA' after approval
For the commercial user the label reads 'Sconto % (max consentito —%)' because maxAllowedStep is null

issues: On a quote with only goods (1 window line), the validated MIXED result shows 'IVA 10% su 0,00 €' plus 22% on everything. That is correct for the beni significativi rule but confusing: the regime label says 'IVA mista' while the effective rate is 22%. Show a note when taxable_10 == 0. The VAT select still reads 'IVA 10% AGEVOLATA' while the applied regime is mixed
'Condizioni' shows the raw code DEPOSIT_50_BALANCE_50, which overflows into the next cell; use the Italian label and wrap the text
The intro paragraph is clipped under the dialog header when content scrolls; DialogContent is missing a Description (Radix a11y warning)
'Valido fino al' uses the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn Calendar

action_items: Align fixed-cost recurrence values between frontend and backend: either add annual/semiannual/bimonthly to FixedCostRecurrence and _monthly_amount (annual=/12, semiannual=/6, bimonthly=/2), or map the UI 'annual' to 'yearly'. Do the same for categories (add logistics/tax/energy/telephony/admin to FixedCostCategory or remove them from CATS)
Validate recurrence/category in FixedCostCreate (Literal) so bad input returns 422/400 instead of 500; show the real error message in the toast
Set approved_by_email on the Admin Master direct-approve path

Initialise discountReason from quote.discount_approval.reason and hide the 'motivazione obbligatoria' warning once status is APPROVED; sync the MarginPanel 'Sconto massimo disponibile' with the 40% cap
Polish: QuoteCashBox payment terms label/overflow, rounding of margin %, a note when VAT 10% taxable is 0
critical_code_review_comments: FixedCostReconciliation.jsx REC/CATS constants are out of sync with models_control.py Literals: an easy contract drift. Expose the allowed values from the backend
management_control.create_fixed builds FixedCost(**d) without a try/except, so pydantic errors leak as 500
QuoteEditorPage.jsx is 994 lines (>700): split the discount section and the totals/VAT section into components
CashCommandCenter.jsx packs very long JSX lines (table rows on single lines): hard to maintain
